sp-acj4-0-real

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{R}\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{arcosh}\left(\cosh x\right) = \left|x\right|\)
Expected
true equal at every admissible point

the two sides are equal at every admissible point

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[0]: acosh cosh _0 -> abs _0

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-0-real (category simplipy-f64-edge)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[0]: acosh cosh _0  ->  abs _0")
  (var x real)
  (ask (= (acosh (cosh x)) (abs x)))
  (expect true)
  (lean-proof "obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := AE.IsReal.exists hd0; refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩; rw [AE.cosh_ofReal, AE.acosh_ofReal (Real.one_le_cosh r), AE.abs_ofReal, ← Real.cosh_abs, Real.arcosh_cosh (abs_nonneg r)]"))

sp-acj4-115-real

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{R},\quad x \neq 0,\quad x > 0,\quad \operatorname{surd}\left(x, -4\right) \neq 0\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \frac{\log x}{-4} = \log\left(\operatorname{surd}\left(x, -4\right)\right)\)
Expected
true equal at every admissible point

the two sides are equal at every admissible point

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[115]: / log _0 (-4) -> log rootn _0 (-4)

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-115-real (category simplipy-f64-edge)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[115]: / log _0 (-4)  ->  log rootn _0 (-4)")
  (var x real)
  (assume (nonzero x))
  (assume (> x 0))
  (assume (nonzero (surd x -4)))
  (ask (= (/ (log x) -4) (log (surd x -4))))
  (expect true)
  (lean-proof "obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := AE.IsReal.exists hd0; have hr : 0 < r := (by simpa using h1.2); refine ⟨⟨h0.2, h2.1.1, h2.2⟩, ?_⟩; rw [show (-4:ℂ) = ((-4:ℤ):ℂ) by norm_num, AE.surd_ofReal_nonneg hr.le (by norm_num), AE.log_ofReal hr.le, AE.log_ofReal (by positivity), Real.log_rpow hr]; simp; ring"))
